text: あら　せんじょう　パーティでは　みかけ　なかった　けど…？

structure.jp: せんじょう　パーティでは
みかけ　なかった　けど…？

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.span: みかけ　なかった　けど
patterns.explanation: けど means 'but'. Left hanging at the end, it softens the remark and invites the other person to answer. みかけ なかった けど = 'I didn't see you, though...'.

patterns.name: 〜では
patterns.explanation: で says where something happened and は puts the spotlight on that place, as if comparing it with others. パーティでは = 'at the party, at least'.
